fusions.name: Shaken Dry
fusions.desc: You shake yourself dry: 4 droplets fly out in a spread to 5 tiles, each dealing 3 water damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Ripples Outward
fusions.desc: Sends a ripple at the first enemy within 6 tiles: it deals 11 water damage and leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles, and you bob up 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Passed Along
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead. You move 20% faster for the first 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dabbler's Scamper

riders.text: you run over it faster than over ground
and blows slide off you while you are on it
and you get your breath back while you are on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you run 15% faster over it, from silver you have 8% more dodge chance on it, and from gold your stamina recovers 20% faster on it.
